name: Braxton Vinson
career_history: Large Projects - Project Controls Leader at DPR Construction, 3/2026 to present; Project Controls Account Lead at DPR Construction, 7/2019 to 4/2026; Project Cost Manager at DPR Construction, 9/2017 to 6/2019; Project Manager at DPR Construction, 8/2015 to 8/2017; Project Engineer at DPR Construction, 5/2011 to 8/2015; Project Engineering Intern at Scott Long Construction, 6/2010 to 8/2010; Transportation Group Design Intern at AECOM, 5/2009 to 8/2009; Sr. Project Controls Manager at DPR Construction
biography:
With 14 years of experience at DPR Construction, I am currently the Project Controls Lead responsible for our largest data center account. In addition to helping lead and develop our great employees, I focus on the delivery of predictable and consistent financial results, utilizing a multitude of internal and external tools, 

DPR Construction exists to build great things. We are a company of builders building great projects, great teams, great relationships, great value.

I approach each day as an opportunity to improve my relationship with our clients, consultants, and subcontractors by executing difficult projects with predictable results. We are a highly technical builder, focused on healthcare, mission critical, higher education, commercial and life sciences projects. We love to take on new and difficult challenges and projects and approach them innovative and out of the box thinking.

When I'm not enjoying building great things at work, I love building great things at my own home. You'll constantly find me in the middle of one project of another both inside and outside of DPR. I also play water polo with a local team in Richmond, and enjoy traveling to new places with my wife and two boys to experience new cultures and fare.
